newsitem.title: INDIA: Gunmen kill seven Hindus in Kashmir - agency.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill seven Hindus in Kashmir - agency.

text.p: Unidentified gunmen shot dead seven Hindus near a village in Kashmir's Badgam district, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said on Saturday.

The news agency, quoting police, said the incident took place on Friday night at Sangrampur-Beerwah in the district forming part of India's Jammu and Kashmir state, where Moslem separatists have been waging a seven-year-old rebellion.
The United News of India (UNI) said the victims were forced out of their homes before being shot. Three bodies were spotted in the area on Saturday morning, it said.
It said senior police officials had rushed to the site of the incident, but gave no other details.
Violence against Hindus in the province, mainly Hindu India's only Moslem majority state, is usually blamed on Islamic separatists.

Thousands of minority Hindus, called Pandits in the Himalayan valley, fled Kashmir after the beginning of the rebellion in the region, where violence linked to insurgency has claimed more than 20,000 lives in the past seven years.
